Name: Caterpillar Inc
Description: Caterpillar Inc. (CAT) is a leading American multinational corporation that specializes in the design, manufacture, and marketing of construction and mining equipment, engines, and related financial products and services. As a Fortune 100 company, Caterpillar has established a robust global presence, supported by an extensive dealer network that enhances its ability to serve a diverse range of industries, including construction, agriculture, and energy. With a strong commitment to innovation and sustainability, Caterpillar continues to leverage advanced technologies to improve efficiency and productivity while addressing environmental challenges in its product offerings.
